notes: Magento 2 PWA Studio SPA (server HTML is an empty shell; no rendered product-count header exists anywhere on the PLP - the grid is Klevu infinite-scroll with limit=20 and hasNextPage). Counts therefore come from the storefront's OWN data source: the Klevu category-merchandising API (eucs26v2.ksearchnet.com, UAE-En key from the site's languageSwitcher GraphQL field), called with the exact categoryPath the PLP builds from category breadcrumbs. Every count was independently confirmed by Magento GraphQL products(filter:{category_uid}).total_count - all 37 categories agreed exactly - and two were additionally verified by enumerating Klevu to exhaustion and counting unique records (vases 43=43=43, chandeliers 9=9=9). RULE 1 TRAP CONFIRMED: Magento's categoryList product_count is heavily inflated (chandeliers 48 vs 9 live, vases 169 vs 43, objet d'art 127 vs 11) because it counts catalogue assignments rather than the shoppable in-stock set; it was NOT used. Cross-checks: decor/wall children 19+9=28=parent exactly, decor/host children 1+27+5+2+1+8=44=parent exactly. Assigned URL /ae/en/ 302-redirects to the real canonical UAE English locale root /en-uae/; all links use /en-uae/. EXCLUDED as out of scope: Fabric (cushions/textiles), Greenery (faux plants), Easels & Plinths, Vinyl (verified to be music LP records, not wall vinyl), Baskets (storage), Festive (holiday), Gifting, Bath, and all furniture/rug categories. Site has NO clocks category. Tablemats kept: verified all 8 are wood, not table linen. Candles kept: verified all 27 are unscented decorative pillar/dinner/hurricane candles, no fragrance line. A second stray 'decor/objet-d-art' category (1 product) duplicating the Accents child was skipped as a catalogue artefact. Stale sitemap entry lighting/lanterns.html no longer exists in the live category tree and was dropped. Reached by direct fetch throughout; no proxy needed.
